# Summary

This mod is simple. Being on top of quadrupedal mobs prevents them from attacking!

Also you can stand on the mob(such as Hoglin)!


## Datapack Tag Support

* wide_mob : When This tag apply the mob. Being on top of quadrupedal mobs prevents them from attacking!

* collidable : when This tag apply the mob. you can stand on the those tagged mob!
